defensiveAbilities.name: Hostile Duet
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A hostile creature within 30 feet creates an effect with the auditory trait that provides bonuses to itself or its allies

Effect The melodic squall recreates the auditory effect, gaining the bonuses for itself and its allies as long as the original effect persists.

defensiveAbilities.name: Retune
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The melodic squall is targeted by a spell with the auditory trait

Effect The melodic squall attempts to counteract the spell. If it succeeds, the spell effect is caught in a blast of wind that sweeps it back to its origin, affecting the caster. Targets of the triggering effect other than the melody on the wind are still affected normally.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mesmerizing Melody
offensiveAbilities.description:
The melodic squall sings in a sonorous chorus. Any creature in a 30ft Emanation must attempt a DC 36 Will Saving Throw save to resist becoming fascinated by the melody on the wind. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Fascinated for 1 round.

Failure The creature is fascinated for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Subsonic Burst
offensiveAbilities.description:
The melodic squall focuses intense sound at an inaudible frequency in a 100ft Line. Each creature in the line must attempt a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 2 and Confused until the beginning of the melodic squall's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swiftness
offensiveAbilities.description: The melodic squall's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Push 10ft
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Push in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Shove the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty. If Push lists a distance, change the distance the creature is pushed on a success to that distance.
